title: Hypericum perforatum tea for medicinal use
intro: Hypericum perforatum tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried flowers and leaves of the St. John's wort plant. It is traditionally used in herbalism to support mood and alleviate symptoms of mild depression. The tea is often consumed as a calming remedy to reduce anxiety and promote emotional well-being. It is also used externally to treat skin conditions and wounds due to its anti-inflammatory properties. However, it should be used with caution as it may interact with certain medications.
